newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sees De Beers deal Feb/Mar-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russia sees De Beers deal Feb/Mar-Interfax.

text.p: A stalled gem deal between De Beers and Russian monopoly diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) is likely to be signed soon, possibly in February or March, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday.
But it quoted Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin as saying that the deal still needed formal approval from President Boris Yeltsin and the Russian government.
Potanin was quoted as saying: "There are no disagreements on matters of principle which could prevent the deal from being signed soon."
De Beers held talks with ARS officials and the Russian government in Moscow last week to try to thrash out a new agreement.

On Monday De Beers' Moscow representative Raymond Clark described last week's talks as constructive and said De Beers would be working with the Russians this week at a working party level. He saw no immediate deal.
Since the end of last year De Beers stopped purchasing Russian diamonds when it cancelled an interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new deal.
